
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/aslanvon/p/19695968" title="发布于 2026-03-10 11:31">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">CPU ↔ DRAM（内存总线）的可持续数据传输带宽</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="最大理论带宽">最大理论带宽</h1>
<p><strong>最大理论带宽（Theoretical Maximum Memory Bandwidth）</strong>，不需要运行复杂的测试，只需要知道两个核心参数：<strong>内存频率</strong>和<strong>内存通道数</strong>。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="1-核心计算公式">1. 核心计算公式</h2>
<p>内存带宽的计算公式如下：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Max Bandwidth (GB/s)} = \frac{\text{Memory Clock (MHz)} \times \text{Bus Width (64-bit)} \times \text{Channels} \times \text{Data Rate (2 for DDR)}}{8 \times 1000}
\]</div><p></p><p>对于 <strong>DDR (Double Data Rate)</strong> 内存，我们通常直接使用其“等效频率”（即厂家标称的频率，如 3200 MT/s）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Max Bandwidth (GB/s)} = \frac{\text{MT/s} \times 8 \text{ Bytes} \times \text{Channels}}{1000}
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p><strong>注意：</strong> 每一条内存插槽的位宽固定为 64-bit（即 8 Bytes）。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="2-在-linux-中获取硬件参数">2. 在 Linux 中获取硬件参数</h2>
<p>你需要确认当前系统运行的内存实际频率和通道数。</p>
<h3 id="第一步获取内存频率和类型">第一步：获取内存频率和类型</h3>
<p>使用 <code>dmidecode</code> 命令查看硬件详情：</p>
<pre><code class="language-Bash">sudo dmidecode -t memory | grep -P "Speed|Type|Part Number"
-- 输出
        Error Correction Type: None
        Type: DDR5
        Type Detail: Synchronous
        Speed: 5600 MT/s
        Part Number: M323R1GB4DB0-CWMOD
        Configured Memory Speed: 4800 MT/s
        Type: DDR5
        Type Detail: Synchronous
        Speed: 5600 MT/s
        Part Number: M323R1GB4DB0-CWMOD
        Configured Memory Speed: 4800 MT/s
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>查找 <strong>Configured Memory Speed</strong>（例如：3200 MT/s）。</li>
<li>注意不要看 <em>Max Speed</em>，那是硬件支持的上限，要看当前运行的 <em>Configured Speed</em>。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="第二步确认通道数-channels">第二步：确认通道数 (Channels)</h3>
<p>通过查看插槽填充情况来判断：</p>
<pre><code class="language-Bash">sudo dmidecode -t memory | grep "Size" | grep -v "No Module Installed"
--输出
        Size: 8 GB
        Non-Volatile Size: None
        Volatile Size: 8 GB
        Cache Size: None
        Logical Size: None
        Size: 8 GB
        Non-Volatile Size: None
        Volatile Size: 8 GB
        Cache Size: None
        Logical Size: None
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>如果有 2 条相同容量的内存，且主板支持双通道，则通道数为 <strong>2</strong>。</li>
<li>如果是服务器级别（如 EPYC 或 Xeon），可能会有 <strong>8</strong> 通道。</li>
</ul>
<p>你是 <strong>DDR4 3200MHz</strong> 且有 <strong>2</strong> 根内存，那么你的最大理论带宽就是 <span class="math inline">\(3200 \times 8 \times 2 / 1000 = 51.2 \text{ GB/s}\)</span>。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="3-快速参考表-以常用配置为例">3. 快速参考表 (以常用配置为例)</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><strong>内存类型</strong></th>
<th><strong>等效频率 (MT/s)</strong></th>
<th><strong>通道数 (Channels)</strong></th>
<th><strong>理论最大带宽 (GB/s)</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>DDR4</td>
<td>2400</td>
<td>1 (单通道)</td>
<td>19.2</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>DDR4</td>
<td>3200</td>
<td>2 (双通道)</td>
<td><strong>51.2</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>DDR4</td>
<td>3200</td>
<td>8 (服务器/EPYC)</td>
<td>204.8</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>DDR5</td>
<td>4800</td>
<td>2 (双通道)</td>
<td>76.8</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>DDR5</td>
<td>6000</td>
<td>2 (双通道)</td>
<td>96.0</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h1 id="使用-stream-验证实际带宽-benchmark">使用 STREAM 验证实际带宽 (Benchmark)</h1>
<hr>
<h2 id="1-理论内存带宽计算">1 理论内存带宽计算</h2>
<p>例如本机配置：</p>
<ul>
<li>Memory type: <strong>DDR5</strong></li>
<li>Configured speed: <strong>4800 MT/s</strong></li>
<li>Bus width: <strong>64 bit = 8 Bytes</strong></li>
<li>Channels: <strong>2</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>理论带宽 = 76.8 GB/s</strong></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="stream-benchmark">STREAM benchmark</h2>
<p>STREAM 是 HPC 领域最常用的 <strong>内存带宽 benchmark</strong>，通过四个 kernel 测试持续内存访问带宽：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Kernel</th>
<th>操作</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Copy</td>
<td><code>a[i] = b[i]</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Scale</td>
<td><code>a[i] = scalar * b[i]</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Add</td>
<td><code>a[i] = b[i] + c[i]</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Triad</td>
<td><code>a[i] = b[i] + scalar * c[i]</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>其中 <strong>Triad</strong> 一般作为最终带宽指标。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="下载-stream">下载 STREAM</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">git clone https://github.com/jeffhammond/STREAM.git
cd STREAM
</code></pre>
<p>为了避免缓存影响，需要增大数组规模，使测试数据远大于 CPU cache。</p>
<p>示例编译：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">gcc -O3 -march=native -fopenmp -mcmodel=large \
-DSTREAM_ARRAY_SIZE=200000000 \
stream.c -o stream
</code></pre>
<p>参数说明：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>参数</th>
<th>作用</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>-O3</td>
<td>编译优化</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>-march=native</td>
<td>使用 CPU SIMD 指令</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>-fopenmp</td>
<td>多线程</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>-mcmodel=large</td>
<td>允许 &gt;2GB 全局数组</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>-STREAM_ARRAY_SIZE</td>
<td>控制数组规模</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2 id="数据规模">数据规模</h2>
<p>配置：</p>
<pre><code>STREAM_ARRAY_SIZE = 200000000
</code></pre>
<p>内存占用：</p>
<pre><code>200M elements × 8 bytes = 1.6 GB / array
3 arrays ≈ 4.5 GB
</code></pre>
<p>该规模已经 <strong>远大于 CPU cache</strong>，可以测试真实 DRAM 带宽。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="运行-benchmark">运行 benchmark</h2>
<p>设置线程数（通常等于 CPU 线程数）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">export OMP_NUM_THREADS=10
./stream
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="测试结果示例">测试结果示例</h2>
<pre><code>precision of your system timer.
-------------------------------------------------------------
Function    Best Rate MB/s  Avg time     Min time     Max time
Copy:           56158.0     0.057857     0.056982     0.058437
Scale:          48954.4     0.067805     0.065367     0.069320
Add:            51523.8     0.095119     0.093161     0.098945
Triad:          51388.6     0.094508     0.093406     0.096107
-------------------------------------------------------------
</code></pre>
<p>换算：</p>
<pre><code>Triad ≈ 51.4 GB/s
</code></pre>
